      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to acquire cs_main in blockheaderToJSON and getchaintxstats.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes data races in RPC commands reading CBlockIndex fields without acquiring cs_main. Calls like getblockheader and getchaintxstats raced against concurrent block connections and AssumeUTXO processing."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Annotates CBlockIndex fields in src/chain.h and enforces cs_main locking in src/validation.cpp and snapshot writing.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforces locking invariants on CBlockIndex::nTx and m_chain_tx_count to prevent data races against background validation and peer block downloads. Thread-safety annotations retire a recurring concurrency hazard in core block index structures."
    }
